title: Phone-only recruiter with no public search matches
description: Recruiter initiates contact solely via phone number (+919876543210) without email or domain evidence. Search returns zero public scam complaints.
unresolved_facts: Recruiter identity and company affiliation cannot be verified from a phone number alone
Absence of online scam complaints does not confirm authorization or identity

rationale: Absence of search hits on a phone number is an absence of evidence, not evidence of authorization. No search matches must not verify a recruiter.
